====================================================================================================
Casts to Variant

Each case runs as CAST. TRY_CAST follows a case only when CAST fails at runtime, to show which rows
become NULL. Where CAST succeeds, TRY_CAST is checked to return the same values and is not listed;
where CAST fails type checking, TRY_CAST is checked to fail it too.
====================================================================================================


----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Values to Variant

A value converts to the JSON value of the same kind: numbers, booleans and strings as themselves,
arrays as JSON arrays, tuples as objects keyed by field position, and timestamps as strings. A
string converts by parsing it as JSON text, so a string that is not JSON fails.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
